notes: Timeline = audio/song.wav; stems share it (zero offset). Bar phase 1 (beat index mod 4 of beat 1): snares on 2 & 4 fix it to half a bar, chord-change novelty (bass+other chroma) picks the rest; first downbeat 0.595 s. Sections from the lyric section tags, starting on the downbeat of the bar holding their first lead word (pickups < 2 beats stay in the previous section).
